name: A5 amendment (signed SMDP, LOYO years; Codex 2026-10-11)

action.kernel: signed kernel, flatten-first reversal, maker 4 bps round trip, stops unchanged

network: 948 -> 64 Tanh -> 64 Tanh; heads target 9, wait 3, value 1 (65,741 params)

folds.normalizer: robust scaling and RV median on the three train years only
folds.episodes: 3 envs per cell x train year (54 envs); 10,080 rollout minutes per env per update (equal year weight); 90-day non-overlapping blocks inside each year, tail included, flat reset

selection: candidates u17/34/51/68, seeds 0/1/2, action RNG 10000..10007 (24 sampled trajectories per cell); score = min over 6 cells of stitched 3 val years [mean net4 - max(0, famvol, ewa)]; all <= 0 -> immediate FAIL, 2025 not run
final: if passed: train 2021..2024 (equal year weight), 5 seeds x 8 RNG = 40 trajectories per cell, single 2025 validation
trace: time, cell, seed, rng, expected_target, sampled_target, wait, executed_U, ret_24h (trailing, bps), signed technique consensus (mean side of available tokens); report-only: Spearman, ret24h tercile target means, long/flat/short share, target switches/day; checkpoints saved even on FAIL
pass_criteria: A3 original: integrity; stitched net4 > 0 6/6; baseline excess 6/6; yearly net4 > 0 24/24; round trips >= 30 24/24; bootstrap p05 > 0 18/18; net4/MDD >= 1 6/6; flat < 0.95; 5-seed ensemble PASS + >= 3/5 seeds 6/6 positive (A4 code had >= 2/3; recorded)
excluded: synthetic sign flip, new regime features, behavioural prior, drift-neutral reward (diagnostics only)
revision: code hash refreshed after the smoke-found window-type fix (no spec change)
